body: Tuesday at dusk: two workers from the pest-control test carried black specks. the garden browned before the checkpoint appeared.
title: Tuesday at dusk — black specks
gloss: A personal trace connects a farm trial to symptoms before a later restriction.
rival_reading: Emergency workers could have picked up the same black specks while responding near a field; this personal trace does not prove the trial caused the emergency.

body:
We reached the gate before dawn. A man with a list asked us to give our names one at a time.

When my companion spoke, the man stopped writing and looked at the person beside him. They argued over which list to use. We could see the road was clear.

They let the others through. We were told to wait for a second count, and I wrote the first count here so it would not disappear.
title: The names at the gate
gloss: An altered count or retained object was left at the scene.
rival_reading: A response to an agricultural exposure could explain the same record or object.
